Definition: an Amalekite (or collectively the Amalekites) or descendants of Amalek
BiblicalUsage: An Amalekite, one of the people of Amalek, and they are in the story from the beginning. Abraham's campaign smites the country of the Amalekites at Kadesh, and the spies report that the Amalekites dwell in the valley of the south; and Saul warns the Kenites to get down from among the Amalekites, lest he destroy them with them, for the Kenites showed kindness to Israel when they came out of Egypt.
TheologicalSignificance: A people named across the whole story carries no lesson of its own. What it shows is the long enmity, that the Amalekites are there when Abraham fights and still there when Saul is told to destroy them.
